item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena tests four colourless liquids found in her kitchen in Jaipur. She dips blue litmus paper and red litmus paper into each liquid and records what she sees.

Liquid P: blue litmus turns red, red litmus stays red.
Liquid Q: red litmus turns blue, blue litmus stays blue.
Liquid R: both papers keep their original colours.
Liquid S: blue litmus turns red, red litmus stays red.

Which liquid should Meena classify as basic?

options.A: Liquid P, because it changes the colour of one litmus paper.
options.B: Liquid Q, because it turns red litmus paper blue.
options.C: Liquid R, because it does not change either litmus paper.
options.D: Liquid S, because both papers stay red after testing.
